SELECT na.id, na.slug, na.title, na.subtitle, na.publish_date as publishDate, na.importance, na.view_count as viewCount, na.average_rating as averageRating, na.image_url as imageUrl, ns.name as sourceName, ns.slug as sourceSlug, (SELECT STRING_AGG(a.name, ', ' ORDER BY a.name) FROM article_authors aa JOIN authors a ON aa.author_id = a.id WHERE aa.article_id = na.id) AS authorNames, (SELECT STRING_AGG(g.name, ', ' ORDER BY g.name) FROM article_genres ag JOIN genres g ON ag.genre_id = g.id WHERE ag.article_id = na.id) AS genres, (SELECT STRING_AGG(g.slug, ', ' ORDER BY g.name) FROM article_genres ag JOIN genres g ON ag.genre_id = g.id WHERE ag.article_id = na.id) AS genreSlugs FROM newspaper_articles na LEFT JOIN newspaper_sources ns ON na.source_id = ns.id WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM na.publish_date) = #{month} AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM na.publish_date) = #{day} AND na.is_active = true ORDER BY na.publish_date DESC, na.importance DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalArticles, SUM(view_count) as totalViews, SUM(save_count) as totalSaves, SUM(comment_count) as totalComments, AVG(average_rating) as averageRating FROM newspaper_articles WHERE is_active = true AND publish_date BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo}

SELECT na.id, na.slug, na.title, na.subtitle, na.publish_date as publishDate, na.view_count as viewCount, na.average_rating as averageRating, na.image_url as imageUrl, ns.name as sourceName, ns.slug as sourceSlug, (SELECT STRING_AGG(g.name, ', ' ORDER BY g.name) FROM article_genres ag JOIN genres g ON ag.genre_id = g.id WHERE ag.article_id = na.id) AS genres, (SELECT STRING_AGG(g.slug, ', ' ORDER BY g.name) FROM article_genres ag JOIN genres g ON ag.genre_id = g.id WHERE ag.article_id = na.id) AS genreSlugs FROM newspaper_articles na LEFT JOIN newspaper_sources ns ON na.source_id = ns.id WHERE na.is_active = true AND na.publish_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' * #{days} ORDER BY na.view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT na.id, na.slug, na.title, na.subtitle, na.publish_date as publishDate, na.view_count as viewCount, na.average_rating as averageRating, na.image_url as imageUrl, ns.name as sourceName, ns.slug as sourceSlug, (SELECT STRING_AGG(a.name, ', ' ORDER BY a.name) FROM article_authors aa JOIN authors a ON aa.author_id = a.id WHERE aa.article_id = na.id) AS authorNames, (SELECT STRING_AGG(g.name, ', ' ORDER BY g.name) FROM article_genres ag JOIN genres g ON ag.genre_id = g.id WHERE ag.article_id = na.id) AS genres, (SELECT STRING_AGG(g.slug, ', ' ORDER BY g.name) FROM article_genres ag JOIN genres g ON ag.genre_id = g.id WHERE ag.article_id = na.id) AS genreSlugs FROM newspaper_articles na LEFT JOIN newspaper_sources ns ON na.source_id = ns.id WHERE na.id != #{articleId} AND na.is_active = true AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM article_genres ag JOIN genres g ON ag.genre_id = g.id WHERE ag.article_id = na.id AND g.slug = #{category} ) ORDER BY na.average_rating DESC, na.view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT na.id, na.slug, na.title, na.subtitle, na.publish_date as publishDate, na.view_count as viewCount, na.average_rating as averageRating, na.image_url as imageUrl, ns.name as sourceName, ns.slug as sourceSlug, (SELECT STRING_AGG(g.name, ', ' ORDER BY g.name) FROM article_genres ag JOIN genres g ON ag.genre_id = g.id WHERE ag.article_id = na.id) AS genres, (SELECT STRING_AGG(g.slug, ', ' ORDER BY g.name) FROM article_genres ag JOIN genres g ON ag.genre_id = g.id WHERE ag.article_id = na.id) AS genreSlugs FROM newspaper_articles na LEFT JOIN newspaper_sources ns ON na.source_id = ns.id WHERE na.publish_date = #{date} AND na.id != #{articleId} AND na.is_active = true ORDER BY na.importance DESC LIMIT #{limit}
